rv.q: But it's a thrilling evening of musical theatre and essential viewing for anyone who has ever looked at their life and wondered: 'How did I get here?'
The show’s an unalloyed treat and a serious pleasure from start to finish.

cn.t: Maria Friedman's revival transforms Sondheim's 1981 flop into a poignant triumph, with critics praising its astute exploration of friendship and disillusionment told in reverse chronology.
